a16z-abridge:ashbyhq:c45524b6-96b2-49f0-.description: ABOUT ABRIDGE Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output.
